# copick sync alignments

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Synchronize alignments between two Copick projects.*

## Usage

```bash
copick sync alignments [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Copies alignments from a source Copick project to a target project; the target runs must hold the tilt series
they align (see `copick sync tiltseries`).

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--source-dataset-ids` | text | `""` | Comma-separated list of dataset IDs to use as source from CryoET Data Portal. If provided, --config will be ignored and a temporary dataportal configuration will be created. |
| `--target-config` | path | **required** | Path to the target configuration file. |
| `--source-runs` | text | `""` | Comma-separated list of source run names to synchronize. If not specified, all runs will be synced. |
| `--target-runs` | text | `""` | Comma-separated mapping of source run names to target run names (e.g. 'run1:target1,run2:target2'). If not specified, source run names will be used. |
| `--names` | text | `""` | Comma-separated list of alignment names to synchronize. If not specified, all alignments will be synced. |
| `--target-ts-types` | text | `""` | Comma-separated mapping of source tilt series types to the target types the copies align (e.g. 'raw:original'). |
| `--valid-only / --no-valid-only` | boolean flag | `False` | Leave out alignments that do not come from their author (e.g. CryoET Data Portal placeholders). |
| `--exist-ok / --no-exist-ok` | boolean flag | `False` | Allow overwriting existing objects in the target project. |
| `--max-workers` | integer | `4` | Maximum number of worker threads to use for synchronization. |
| `--log / --no-log` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable verbose logging of the synchronization process. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
# Copy the alignments from their authors of a portal dataset
copick sync alignments --source-dataset-ids 10445 --target-config local.json --valid-only
```
